intro.title: About ADO Center
intro.subtitle: Building hope, resilience, and healthier communities through accessible mental health and psychosocial support.
intro.p1: ADO Center is a community-focused mental health and psychosocial support organization dedicated to improving the emotional well-being and quality of life of individuals and families in Anse-à-Galets, La Gonâve, Haiti.
intro.p2: Our organization believes that mental health is a fundamental human right. We work to ensure that children, adolescents, adults, older adults, and vulnerable populations have access to compassionate, confidential, and evidence-based mental health services regardless of their social or economic background.
intro.p3: Through counseling, psychiatric care, psychosocial support, education, and community outreach, we strive to create healthier individuals, stronger families, and more resilient communities.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: The ADO Center was established in response to the growing and critical need for mental health services in La Gonâve. The community faces numerous challenges, including poverty, limited healthcare access, geographic isolation, and the lingering effects of recurring natural disasters.
story.p2: These overwhelming challenges have contributed to increased rates of depression, anxiety, psychological trauma, substance use disorders, and severe untreated psychiatric conditions, often leaving individuals and families without a place to turn.
story.p3: Driven by the vision of creating accessible and sustainable mental health care, we set out to build a center that not only provides professional treatment but also actively works to reduce the stigma surrounding mental illness in our culture.
story.p4: Today, we stand as a beacon of hope, bringing professional mental health and psychosocial support services directly to the people who need them most.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To improve psychological well-being, strengthen resilience, and expand access to high-quality mental health and psychosocial support services for individuals, families, and communities throughout La Gonâve.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: A future where every individual has access to compassionate, affordable, and culturally appropriate mental health care, empowering communities to thrive with dignity, hope, and resilience.

founder.title: Our Founder
founder.name: Ruthe Antoine, LCSW, CSSW
founder.bio1: Ruthe Antoine founded the ADO Center with a profound vision: to ensure that no one in La Gonâve has to face mental health challenges alone.
founder.bio2: With extensive experience in clinical social work, she recognized the critical gap in mental health services and the devastating impact of untreated trauma and psychological distress within the community.
founder.bio3: Her commitment to accessible, compassionate mental health care drives the center's mission to break down barriers, eliminate stigma, and provide culturally responsive support that truly empowers individuals and families to heal and thrive.

whyMatters.title: Why Mental Health Matters
whyMatters.p1: Mental health affects every aspect of life, including education, employment, family relationships, physical health, and community development.
whyMatters.p2: By investing in mental health, communities become healthier, stronger, safer, and more resilient. We believe that true well-being is impossible without mental well-being.
